analysis.reported_speed_rejected: velocity.speed median 10.5 m/s conflicted with coordinate ground speed 35.8-39.4 m/s
analysis.roll_response_basis: ground-course response proxy; attitude was not present
analysis.camera_command_response_s: 0.2 for FOV/coordinate commands; 1.0-2.2 for line-search activation
analysis.camera_fov_method: discrete values were retained because no intermediate zoom samples were observed
analysis.camera_los_method: world-frame angular response calibrated from sensorInfo.centerCoordinate; true gimbal attitude was not present
analysis.footprint_polygon_order: clockwise and convex for every valid record
analysis.footprint_method: center ray intersects DEM; corner rays intersect the quantized horizontal plane at the center-hit altitude

notes: This profile is loaded only by the SIM runtime and never overwrites the shared planner dynamics profile.
The existing 30 m/s=340 m and 40 m/s=450 m reference-radius table already matched the observed maneuver bands, so its scale remains 1.0.
Target waypoint speed, bank limits, pitch limits, and climb/descent envelopes remain unchanged.
Roll values are course-response proxies because the validation 0401 data did not contain attitude.
Camera FOV stays discrete, while mode/command delay and world-frame LOS rate are applied only by the Shinil SIM toggle.
Aircraft-fixed Mode 4 applies the simulated body roll/pitch/yaw directly without an invented gimbal slew; Mode 3 tracking, ROI, forced control, and loiter retain their established behavior.
The source 0401 logs recorded flat, equal-altitude corners, but the runtime intentionally does not reproduce that approximation.
Detection, 0401 serialization, and display use the same four independent regional-DEM ray intersections regardless of the Shinil toggle.
The current exact projection is cached per aircraft and reused until aircraft pose, camera focus, FOV, or image axis changes.
